scope: loss/closure/fire/disaster affecting the only, sole, last, or full-service grocery store in a community
canceled/suspended emergency food distributions due to storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
abrupt pantry/food-bank service closure or major access reduction
new official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.result: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption identified in the bounded window.
exclusions: Kauaʻi emergency food distributions were proceeding as scheduled rather than canceled or suspended.
Other surfaced matches were stale, outside the United States, routine program information, or otherwise outside the watch criteria.
coverage_notes.production_authority: Primary nationwide Food Line production collection remains authoritative.
